description: Data freshness of the weather platform (no inputs needed; refreshed about every 5 minutes): overall state, per-source states (ok / degraded / outage / no_signal), open incidents with their cause (provider outage vs internal processing delay) and active provider advisories. Use it when asked whether data is current, when other tools return stale-looking data, or before presenting time-critical weather. If a source is degraded or in outage, say the data may be stale rather than presenting it as live. Example: {}.

include_ok.description: true: every monitored source, healthy ones too. false (default): only sources that are not ok.

name: get_status

generated_at.description: When the status document was generated (UTC).

overall.description: Worst state across customer-facing data sources; "unknown" when status is unavailable.

warming.description: true when no_signal only means monitoring is still warming up (not an outage).

title: Get status
